[EN] Are you a member of the collective? You sure don't look familiar. Are you here about money? This isn't a bank, you know.
[ES] ¿Eres miembro del colectivo? Desde luego no me suenas de nada. ¿Vienes por dinero? Esto no es un banco, ya sabes.

[EN] Help the collective and the collective helps you! Now, let's talk tithes...

[EN] Sorry, I'm very busy right now—no time to chat. I have numbers to run and figure to...well, figure. Let's see, I was at...oh, now I've lost count!
